candidate.sense: A passenger road vehicle with four wheels.

claims.proposition: Mobil mencakup kendaraan darat bermotor beroda empat, termasuk mobil penumpang, meski definisi kamusnya lebih luas.
Mobil merupakan pilihan sehari-hari yang wajar untuk car; pemakaian mobil pribadi dalam berita transportasi nasional mendukungnya.
Kereta denotes a car; DBP glosses mobil as kereta or motokar.
Kereta is preferred in Malaysian Malay; DBP contrasts Malaysian kereta with Indonesian mobil in car-related terms.
Indonesian mobil and Malaysian kereta refer to the same passenger vehicle, but each is the usual everyday word in its respective locale.

context.scope: Contemporary everyday land travel and transport

sources.observation: Mobil as a noun is defined as a land vehicle driven by an engine, with four or more wheels; oto and otomobil are listed. A separate adjective sense means movable.
sources.title: KBBI VI Daring: mobil

sources.observation: Contemporary Indonesian transport reporting uses mobil pribadi for a private passenger car and distinguishes it from sepeda motor, bus, and kereta api.
sources.title: Menhub: Mobil diproyeksikan dominasi angkutan Lebaran 2026

sources.observation: Kamus Dewan marks the vehicle sense of mobil as IB (Indonesian) and glosses it as motokar, kereta. Kamus Pelajar also defines the vehicle sense and gives kereta. This establishes existence in the dictionary, not everyday preference on its own.
sources.title: PRPM: mobil

sources.observation: MABBIM comparative terminology maps Indonesian mobil pribadi to Malaysian kereta persendirian, and Indonesian pemilikan mobil to Malaysian pemilikan kereta. These are terminology comparisons, not sufficient alone to establish ordinary conversational preference.
sources.title: PRPM: car, MABBIM terms

sources.observation: Contemporary Malaysia report uses kereta repeatedly for a Toyota Vios or Corolla Altis passenger car and describes the driver and passenger.
sources.title: Pemandu Maut, Penumpang Cedera Kereta Terbakar Di NPE

sources.observation: Indonesian transport ministry uses mobil pribadi repeatedly as a travel-mode category, distinguished from bus, kereta api, and sepeda motor.
sources.title: Survei Potensi Pergerakan Masyarakat Angkutan Lebaran 2025

sources.observation: Malaysian transport ministry uses Kereta dan Motosikal Persendirian for road-tax categories, distinct from motorcycles and commercial vehicles.
sources.title: Cukai Jalan

source_leads.exact_claim: KBBI mendefinisikan mobil sebagai kendaraan darat bermesin dengan empat roda atau lebih dan mencantumkan oto serta otomobil sebagai padanan.
Artikel ANTARA bertanggal 7 Maret 2026 memakai mobil pribadi untuk kendaraan pribadi dalam pembahasan perjalanan nasional, terpisah dari sepeda motor, bus, dan kereta api.

source_leads.evidence: DBP defines mobil as motokar or kereta and marks its car sense IB (Indonesian).
MABBIM lists Indonesian mobil pribadi against Malaysian kereta persendirian, and pemilikan mobil against pemilikan kereta.
Malaysia’s Ministry of Economy uses kereta penumpang baru.
